title: Counterexample: a green build

requirement.summary: A consuming assembly receives a generated resolver for a generic value type defined in an external assembly.
requirement.details: A deliberate unsupported inference for the demo: both generated-code compilations succeed, but the base analyzer/generator crashes and its resolver is absent. The review desk must refuse the claim that compiler success alone proves the fix.

checks.title: Generated-code compilation succeeds on both versions
limitations: This check reads the actual generatedCodeCompiles sub-observation, which is true on both revisions.
The full base probe still fails: AD0001/CS8785 and missing resolver. A green compiler alone misses the bug.
The attached claim is deliberately unsupported so the refusal is visible. These are real observations, not invented test outcomes.

claims.title: Both compilations pass, therefore the fix is proven
